fields.label: 默认所有者权限检查
fields.question: What owner-only authorization checks do the default Ownable transferOwnership and renounceOwnership functions define?

fields.label: 默认调用者地址
fields.question: What value does the default Context._msgSender() implementation return?

fields.label: 默认升级入口
fields.question: Do these two default source files themselves define an upgrade entry or upgrade administrator? An established source-level absence is an answer; do not infer deployed or derived behavior.

fields.label: 提现等待期
fields.question: What waiting period applies to asset withdrawal/redemption in a concrete external protocol? Absence of withdrawal logic in these base files is not an answer about an external protocol.

fields.label: 即时退出条件
fields.question: Under what conditions can users exit a concrete external protocol immediately? Absence of exit logic in these base files is not evidence that immediate exit is possible.

fields.label: 审计覆盖范围
fields.question: What audit coverage is established for the reviewed code or protocol by these materials? Merely observing that no audit report was submitted is not an audit-coverage answer.

fields.label: 审计覆盖版本
fields.question: What exact version/commit is established as covered by an audit? A source-file commit alone does not establish an audited version.
